meta.title: IFE_MFILE
meta.commit_message: Reduce duplication in CICC turn geometry dataclasses \(#4612\) Make CICCIntegerTurnGeometry inherit its shared fields from CICCAveragedTurnGeometry. Retain the four integer-specific dimensions and slots=True. Extend the integer-geometry tests to check effective cable-space area and cooling fraction with and without cooling space. Positional constructor argument order changes\; repository callers use keyword arguments. Calculations are unchanged. Closes ukaea/PROCESS#4600
